description: Main application entry point for a service that loads configuration, manages controller execution based on enabled features, and handles status messaging and error reporting.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that loads configuration and initiates controller execution and HTTP status handling.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes enabled controllers and updates status messages.

methods.name: getEnabledControllers
methods.description: Returns a list of controller functions that are enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: disabledFnNullified
methods.description: Returns a no-op function if the controller is disabled; otherwise returns the original controller function.

methods.name: topLevelErrorHandle
methods.description: Handles errors at the top level by updating status and printing error messages.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads application configuration from a JSON file.
